name: Stratholme

entrance.note: Two Horde-usable gates in Plaguewood. Living/Scarlet (main gate) 26.5, 10.4 (Era 31.3, 15.7). Undead/Baron (Service Entrance / Eastwall Gate) 41.5, 17.7 (Era 47.9, 23.9). Forever pins converted from Era in dungeons.json. Main gate needs no key. Service Entrance needs Key to the City (item 12382 from Magistrate Barthilas) or a rogue with Lockpicking 300. Catalog wings: Live (Scarlet side, main gate), Undead (service entrance, Baron).

travel.how: Fly Light's Hope Chapel and ride northwest into Plaguewood; main gate is the western pin, service entrance the eastern pin. Do not send Horde to Chillwind or Alliance Eastwall Tower camps.

quests.name: Redemption
quests.notes: Talk quest. QDB/catalog allOf Demon Dogs 5542, Blood Tinged Skies 5543, Carrion Grubbage 5544 (those three are owned by the 40-60 pack, not this dungeon pack). Tirion's cabin is west EPL, not Light's Hope — drop unless the route already visits him. Unlocks 5781.

quests.name: Of Forgotten Memories
quests.notes: Outdoor EPL (Gahrron's Withering crypt). Catalog speedrun:true as a dungeon prereq; still optional here because Tirion is off the Light's Hope hub. Unlocks 5845.

quests.name: Of Lost Honor
quests.notes: Outdoor Northdale symbol. Unlocks 5846.

quests.name: Of Love and Family
quests.notes: Talk to Artist Renfray on Caer Darrow (Horde-accessible island, not Chillwind). Catalog balanced-only. Unlocks 5848.

quests.name: Of Love and Family
quests.notes: Living/Scarlet side: recover the painting Of Love and Family from the Scarlet Bastion. Catalog speedrun:false.

quests.name: The Medallion of Faith
quests.notes: Accepted from Aurius inside (Alonsus Chapel, undead-side chapel near the service door). Loot the Medallion of Faith from the mailbox in the Scarlet Bastion (living side) and return it. XP not in QuestieDB (use 0). Unlocks 5125 after Baron.

quests.name: Aurius' Reckoning
quests.notes: After 5122, kill Baron Rivendare (undead side) and return to Aurius. Catalog speedrun:true. Steps-v2: Will of the Martyr / Blood of the Martyr.

quests.name: The Flesh Does Not Lie
quests.notes: Plagued flesh samples inside (both sides). Light's Hope. Catalog balanced+speedrun. Unlocks 5213.

quests.name: The Active Agent
quests.notes: Scourge Data from ziggurats on the undead side after 5212 is turned in at LHC — usually a second visit. Catalog speedrun:false.

quests.name: The Great Fras Siabi
quests.notes: Living/Scarlet side: Fras Siabi's tobacco. Catalog wing Live. Catalog speedrun:false (travel why); giver is Light's Hope so keep for an at-60 live-side run.

quests.name: Houses of the Holy
quests.notes: Stratholme Holy Water from crates (both sides, mostly living). Catalog speedrun:false.

quests.name: The Archivist
quests.notes: Living/Scarlet side: kill Archivist Galford and burn the archive. Catalog wing Live, balanced+speedrun. Unlocks 5262 (item).

quests.name: The Truth Comes Crashing Down
quests.notes: Living side: Head of Balnazzar starts this after 5251. Turn in at Light's Hope. Unlocks 5263.

quests.name: Above and Beyond
quests.notes: Undead/Baron side: kill Baron Rivendare. Catalog wing Undead. Needs the living-side Balnazzar head first. Catalog balanced+speedrun.

quests.name: The Restless Souls
quests.notes: Alen is south of Light's Hope; turn-in is Egan in Terrordale (northwest EPL, near Strat). Catalog balanced-only. Unlocks 5282. Drop if it adds a Terrordale detour before the run.

quests.name: The Restless Souls
quests.notes: Use Egan's Blaster on restless souls inside (both sides). Catalog speedrun:false.

quests.name: The Human, Ras Frostwhisper
quests.notes: Requires Scholomance Kirtonos 5384 first (cross-dungeon). Keepsake from Stormwind (Alliance city) in Classic — Horde still uses this quest in QuestieDB; do not send players into Stormwind as a hub. Drop unless 5384 is already done. Unlocks 5462.

quests.name: The Dying, Ras Frostwhisper
quests.notes: Deliver the keepsake to Leonid at Light's Hope. Unlocks 5463.

quests.name: Menethil's Gift
quests.notes: Undead side: use the keepsake at Menethil's Gift (object in Baron's slaughterhouse). Catalog speedrun:true but still optional because of the Scholo Kirtonos gate.

quests.name: Menethil's Gift
quests.notes: Accepted from the Menethil's Gift object after 5463. README moved this follow-up into Stratholme so it is not accepted before 5463.

quests.name: Soulbound Keepsake
quests.notes: Return the charged keepsake to Marduke on Caer Darrow. Unlocks 5466 (done inside Scholomance, not Strat).

quests.name: The Lich, Ras Frostwhisper
quests.notes: Kill Ras Frostwhisper inside SCHOLOMANCE with the Soulbound Keepsake. README keeps the accept in the Stratholme pack after 5463 so the chain is not offered early. Optional: needs a Scholo run after Strat.

quests.name: Duskwing, Oh How I Hate Thee...
quests.notes: Outdoor elite Duskwing. QDB and README pre.group is 6022+6042+6133; catalog listed only anyOf 6133. Those world prereqs are owned by the 40-60 pack. steps-v2 has no accept/turnin for 6135. Unlocks 6163 together with 6136. Drop unless the route already stands at Marris Stead.

quests.name: Ramstein

Marris Stead is south EPL, not Light's Hope. steps-v2 has no accept:6163/turnin:6163 (not in the dungeon step id list). Drop the Nathanos chain rather than a Marris Stead detour.

keys: No quest key. Service Entrance (undead/Baron side, 41.5, 17.7) opens with Key to the City (item 12382) looted from Magistrate Barthilas inside Stratholme, or a rogue with Lockpicking 300. First visit: enter the main gate (living side, 26.5, 10.4), clear to Barthilas at the junction, loot the key. Engineers/blacksmiths can blast/skeleton-key the service doors in Classic; not in the catalog.
Living/Scarlet side = main gate, Archivist Galford / Balnazzar / Fras Siabi. Undead/Baron side = service entrance or the inner gate after Barthilas, Ramstein / Baron Rivendare / Menethil's Gift.
The Scarlet Key is a Scarlet Monastery key and is not required for Strat living side in this catalog.

prep.group: 5-player, dungeon levels 58-60. placement at60: minimum 58 so min+2 is 60 — this dungeon does NOT fit the +2 rule before 60. Run both sides once at 60 (steps-v2: do not reset for another Baron).
warnings: placement at60 and runAt 60. Do not splice an inline Strat run in the 50s.
Living side first if nobody has Key to the City; loot Barthilas, then service entrance for Baron.
Core Light's Hope at-60 pickups: 5212, 5214, 5243, 5251 (then 5262 inside, 5263 after Balnazzar, 5122/5125 with Aurius).
Drop Tirion (west EPL), Nathanos (Marris Stead), Malyfous (Everlook+BRS), and the Ras chain (needs Scholo Kirtonos 5384) rather than adding detours.
Live side: pull Scarlet packs one at a time. Undead side: abominations hit hard; dispel disease (catalog role tips).
Holy Water crates for 5243; do not farm extra resets.

speedrunReplaceCandidates.why: At 60 a both-sides Strat run can replace leftover EPL outdoor kill quests on horde-40-60 (Tirion dog/bat/grub loop is already a Strat prereq, not a replacement target if 5742 is kept).
Catalog dungeons-off names Silithus with EPL and Winterspring; an at-60 Strat block can replace the first Cenarion Hold loop.
Leftover Everlook kill quests on horde-40-60 in the same endgame band.

sourceConflicts: placement: dungeon minimum 58, so the +2 rule lands at 60. Catalog levelRange is 58-60. This dossier sets placement at60 and runAt 60 as instructed.
6135: catalog prerequisites anyOf [6133] vs QDB/README group [6022, 6042, 6133]. Used QDB group.
6163: catalog anyOf [6135] vs QDB group [6135, 6136] and README 'Ramstein needs The Corpulent One 6136'. Used QDB group. steps-v2 has no accept/turnin ids for 6135 or 6163.
5461-5466 live in the Stratholme pack after 5463 (README pack-fixes) even though 5466 is completed in Scholomance.
5067/5063/5068/5122 have no XP in QuestieDB or dungeons.json (xp 0).
Service Entrance key is an item drop (12382), not a quest; not listed in dungeons.json keys.
Classic Era XP; catalog notes Forever may halve dungeon-quest bonus XP (unofficial).
notes: Horde Stratholme, levels 58-60. placement at60: the dungeon minimum is 58, so min+2 is 60 and it does not fit the +2 rule before 60 — put it in the at-60 end block, not inline in 50-60. Living/Scarlet side (main gate, no key) vs undead/Baron side (Service Entrance, Key to the City from Barthilas or lockpicking 300). Run both sides once at 60 from Light's Hope. Core LHC quests 5212, 5214, 5243, 5251, 5262, 5263, 5122, 5125. Optional: Tirion chain, Nathanos/Ramstein, Egan, Ras/Scholo follow-up, Malyfous, and all DS2/Valthalak. Dungeons-off: Eastern Plaguelands, Winterspring and Silithus.
